## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to assert RCC-8 Disconnected — two regions share no point; symmetric.

### Avoid when

- Avoid mixing RCC-8 relations for one region pair (the set is pairwise-disjoint; exactly one holds) and avoid it where touching (EC) or containment is meant.

### How to use

- Assert one RCC-8 relation per region pair; the gmeow:rcc8* relations are declared pairwise-disjoint.
